verdict.rationale: Phoenix has no named sandbox or test mode, but the evidence supports isolated testing. You can spin up a local or self-hosted instance with `uvx arize-phoenix serve`, kept entirely within your infrastructure and optionally air-gapped. Projects keep traces for different applications separate, and experiments rerun curated datasets (which can come from staging or be built manually) against new app versions instead of live traffic. Missing for 10: a documented first-class sandbox/test environment, explicit guidance on isolating test runs from production projects and data, and hands-on corroboration of such a workflow.
